result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but it omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law, so it does not reach the playbook position. It also unnecessarily requires all coverages to continue for one year after expiration, which is not required by the playbook and may be unsuitable for occurrence-based CGL coverage. The original entire-agreement provision is otherwise preserved, and the added language is generally clear.
